name: Trailer Fetcher
description: Finds and downloads missing local movie trailers from YouTube via yt-dlp.
overview: Finds and downloads missing local movie trailers from YouTube via yt-dlp.

versions.changelog: Fixed a real stability bug: the compiled assembly never had its own Version/AssemblyVersion set, so it silently defaulted to .NET's "1.0.0.0" regardless of what the manifest declared - causing the dashboard to revert to "1.0.0.0" after a task run or restart, and uninstall to fail outright. Also moved the scheduled task into the "Library" category, fixed a stray quoted-string artifact in one log line, and added diagnostic logging to help track down a reported "0 movies found" when scoped to a specific library.
